camel_example: aliyun live CreateLivePrivateLine --region cn-hangzhou --VideoCenter 'cn-shanghai' --StreamName testStream --DomainName 'demo.aliyundoc.com' --AccelerationType play --Reuse no --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AccelerationArea 'ap-southeast-1' --AppName live
description_en: Creates an Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance and attaches it to a live streaming link
description_zh: 创建全球加速实例并绑定到直播链路
kebab_example: aliyun live create-live-private-line --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name demo.aliyundoc.com --app-name live --stream-name testStream --video-center cn-shanghai --acceleration-type play --acceleration-area ap-southeast-1 --reuse no --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLivePrivateLine

parameters.help_en: The live center. Valid values: cn-beijing, cn-shanghai, cn-shenzhen, cn-qingdao, ap-northeast-1, ap-southeast-5, eu-central-1, ap-southeast-1, and ap-south-1, which represent the live centers in Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Qingdao, Japan, Indonesia, Germany, and Singapore respectively
parameters.help_zh: 直播中心，取值：cn-beijing、cn-shanghai、cn-shenzhen、cn-qingdao、ap-northeast-1、ap-southeast-5、eu-central-1、ap-southeast-1、ap-south-1，分别表示位于北京、上海、深圳、青岛、日本、印尼、德国、新加坡的直播中心
parameters.name: video_center

parameters.help_en:
The acceleration type. Valid values:

play: streaming acceleration.
publish: stream ingest acceleration
parameters.help_zh:
加速类型，取值：

play：播流加速。
publish：推流加速
parameters.name: acceleration_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to reuse an existing acceleration channel. Valid values:
yes: Reuse an existing acceleration channel.
no: Create a new acceleration channel
parameters.help_zh:
是否复用已有加速通道，取值：
yes：复用已有加速通道。
no：新建加速通道
parameters.name: reuse

parameters.help_en: The acceleration bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s. This parameter is required when Reuse is set to no
parameters.help_zh: 加速带宽，单位：Mbps。当Reuse为no时必填
parameters.name: max_bandwidth

parameters.help_en: The ID of the acceleration channel to reuse. This parameter is required when Reuse is set to yes
parameters.help_zh: 复用的加速通道。当Reuse为yes时必填
parameters.name: instance_id
